controls.control_name: Host, OS, container and network isolation
controls.read_only_procedure: Review signed host/container/network inventory from approved nonproduction boundary. Compare read-only ingress/egress, UID and namespace-denial observations to the frozen candidate. No host session opened.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Independent host inventory and signed OS/runtime configuration
Ingress, egress, namespace and privilege-denial observations on approved isolated host

controls.read_only_procedure: Review redacted certificate-chain and proxy-header inspection records for an authorized isolated endpoint. Do not scan, probe, or modify any external/production edge.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Observed TLS chain and lifecycle/renewal test on approved endpoint
Validated trusted proxy, headers and public-edge routing

controls.read_only_procedure: Review only redacted vault inventory, access-policy metadata, and prior authorized rotation-denial receipts. Never retrieve, rotate, copy or print credentials.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Approved redacted vault inventory and secret segregation
Independent rotation, expiry, access-denial and audit receipts

controls.control_name: Operator enrollment, RBAC, MFA and revocation
controls.read_only_procedure: Inspect policy revisions, role matrix and synthetic revoked-session checks. Request separate human enrollment, MFA recovery and device-revocation receipts; no live user/session changes.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Named identity and approved enrollment/MFA recovery record
Revocation and cross-instance deny-path evidence without execution permissions

controls.read_only_procedure: Review signed DB ownership, grants and audit-chain inventories, plus disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL CI results. No production SQL session or mutation.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Signed cluster identity, roles, grants and inherited-grant audit
Isolated nonproduction write-denial and audit tamper evidence

controls.read_only_procedure: Review timestamped encrypted-backup digests and independently approved isolated restore and rollback receipts. Do not initiate a backup, restore or rollback on any authoritative host.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Encrypted backup digest and isolated restore proof
Audit-chain continuity, rollback drill and operator receipt

controls.control_name: Broker account and session read-only acceptance
controls.independent_review_role: Independent Provider Risk and Security reviewer
controls.read_only_procedure: Review broker-provider approval letter and signed prior read-only account/session acceptance receipts if supplied. No login, callback registration, account query, token renewal or order API call.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Broker-approved identity, outbound IP and callback acceptance
Read-only account/session/exposure receipts with no order calls

controls.read_only_procedure: Review provider authorization and supplied freshness, sequence, failover and recovery observation logs. No provider connection or live-feed subscription.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Authorized feed identity, freshness and sequence observations
Staleness, disconnect, failover and recovery proof

controls.read_only_procedure: Review approved alert-rule definitions, signed independent delivery receipts and human acknowledgment records. No external notification sent.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Real infrastructure metrics and alert rules
Independent external delivery and human acknowledgment receipts

controls.independent_review_role: Independent Code and Execution Safety reviewer
controls.read_only_procedure: Review static broker-access inventory, finding dispositions and code-owner receipts against frozen SHA. No routing, connection, execution-path activation or transaction.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Disposition and signed review of inherited access findings
Negative authorization-path inventory and no unauthorized broker-write reachability

controls.control_name: Full app, device, resilience and vulnerability review
controls.read_only_procedure: Review synthetic CI and real Chromium browser evidence separately; request independent device, vulnerability and resilience receipts. Do not classify mocked browser tests as real-device or production acceptance.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Real-device cross-surface auth, layout and performance results
Security review, dependency decision and resilience/load evidence

controls.independent_review_role: Separate Security, Operations and Release approvers
controls.read_only_procedure: Cross-check immutable evidence manifest, reviewer independence, exception dispositions and separate signed decisions. No approval or GO may be generated by automation.
prerequisites: Written scope authorization from responsible human
Immutable candidate/build identity
Approved isolated environment if needed
Redacted immutable storage with SHA-256 receipt
expected_independent_evidence: Immutable evidence bundle with owners, environment and reviewers
Separate security, operations and release signatures and new go/no-go review

governance_review_checklist.item: Freeze candidate and route evidence to separated non-production reviewer
Human owner and evidence collector appointed for every control
Independent real-world environment, failure/denial and recovery receipt references provided
Separate named reviewer validates each evidence digest and exceptions
Security, database, operations and provider approval independently signed

receipt_contract.storage_policy: Restricted reviewed store with opaque references; no sensitive material in GitHub
